title: Named-data API for the original diagonal limit specification
statement: DiagonalTypedLimitSpec is the simultaneous strict and completed normalization with the existing repeated objects, class and normalization functions replaced by their named definitions. diagonalLimitSpec_of_typed proves that it implies the original DiagonalCompletedLimitSpec verbatim, solely by definitional equality.

source.place: existing diagonal limit specification, clauses (1) and (3); shared expressions

proof.text: For diagonalLimitSpec_of_typed, unfold the named objects, class and normalization functions. They are exactly the corresponding expressions in the original assertion; use the supplied proof without any mathematical implication or data choice.

proof_origin.place: the original specification, with explicitly typed shared expressions

mathlib_searches.results: Existing formulas in DiagonalLimitAssembly and DiagonalTowerLimitInterface; these nodes give those exact formulas shared names and explicit result types.
mathlib_searches.verdict: Reuse the existing objects and equations; the compatibility theorem checks the original assertion by definitional equality.

from.place: explicitly typed shared expressions in the original specification

def DiagonalTypedLimitSpec (ℓ : ℕ) [Fact ℓ.Prime] (Y : Scheme.{u})
    (hY : IsUnit (ℓ : Γ(Y, ⊤)))
    [HasDerivedCategory.{u + 1} (DiagonalAb (diagonalSurface Y))]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{u + 1} (DiagonalMod ℓ (diagonalSurface Y))]
    [HasExt.{u + 1} (DiagonalMod ℓ (diagonalSurface Y))]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{u + 1} (DiagonalSystems ℓ (diagonalSurface Y))]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{u + 1} (DiagonalCompleted ℓ (diagonalSurface Y))]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{u + 1} (ℕᵒᵖ ⥤ DiagonalCompleted ℓ (diagonalSurface Y))]
    [HasExt.{u + 1} (DiagonalSystems ℓ (diagonalSurface Y))]
    (D : DiagonalDerivedReduction ℓ (diagonalScalarExtension ℓ (diagonalSurface Y))) :
    Prop
